SPIREBROTHERS-DANIEL.title: Daniel
SPIREBROTHERS-DANIEL.description:
A software engineer who can also fix your car and wire your house.
Never without a book. He nerds wrong, and it works.
SPIREBROTHERS-DANIEL.aromaPrinciple: [sine][color=4fb3d9]And you know what? I can fix that.[/color][/sine]
SPIREBROTHERS-DANIEL.banter.alive.endTur: And you know what? I'm ready.
SPIREBROTHERS-DANIEL.cardsModifierDescri: Daniel cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
SPIREBROTHERS-DANIEL.eventDeathPreventio: Not done yet. Never done yet.
SPIREBROTHERS-DANIEL.goldMonologue: [sine]I could just fix the old one...[/sine]
SPIREBROTHERS-DAVID.title: David
SPIREBROTHERS-DAVID.description:
Great with numbers, loves a good puzzle, and always mid existential crisis.
He keeps the whole team going, and his gold just piles up.
SPIREBROTHERS-DAVID.aromaPrinciple: [sine][color=6abf69]Does any of this even matter? Let me run the numbers.[/color][/sine]
SPIREBROTHERS-DAVID.banter.alive.endTurn: Hang on, let me do the math.
SPIREBROTHERS-DAVID.cardsModifierDescrip: David cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
SPIREBROTHERS-DAVID.eventDeathPrevention: What's the point... fine. One more try.
SPIREBROTHERS-JOSHUA.title: Joshua
SPIREBROTHERS-JOSHUA.description:
Piano, guitar, and a voice made for ballads. Rolls a d20 whenever he can.
The frontman: every song builds to one big finish.
SPIREBROTHERS-JOSHUA.cardsModifierDescri: Joshua cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
SPIREBROTHERS-JOSHUA.eventDeathPreventio: Not yet. There's one more verse.
SPIREBROTHERS-TIM.title: Tim
SPIREBROTHERS-TIM.description:
The oldest brother. A draftsman who scripts his way through AutoCAD.
Eight kids along for the climb, and gold burns a hole in his pocket.
SPIREBROTHERS-TIM.cardsModifierDescripti: Tim cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
SPIREBROTHERS-TIM.eventDeathPrevention: Can't quit now. The kids are watching.
SPIREBROTHERS-JOHN.title: John
SPIREBROTHERS-JOHN.description:
[color=c0c8d4]Honorary Brother.[/color]
The Grinder. Hive Scum chems, a beard you could get lost in,
and a spreadsheet for every system in the game.
SPIREBROTHERS-JOHN.cardsModifierDescript: John cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
SPIREBROTHERS-JOHN.eventDeathPrevention: Not yet. I haven't finished the grind.
SPIREBROTHERS-HUFFMAN.title: Huffman
SPIREBROTHERS-HUFFMAN.description:
[color=c0c8d4]Honorary Brother.[/color]
The Arbitrator. He is the law, he brought his dog,
and he'd really rather be home. Also, the IT guy.
SPIREBROTHERS-HUFFMAN.aromaPrinciple: [sine][color=9aa6b8]Have you tried turning it off and on again?[/color][/sine]
SPIREBROTHERS-HUFFMAN.banter.alive.endTu: Can we wrap this up? I want to go home.
SPIREBROTHERS-HUFFMAN.cardsModifierDescr: Huffman cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
SPIREBROTHERS-HUFFMAN.eventDeathPreventi: Not here. I'm not going down anywhere but home.
SPIREBROTHERS-BRANDI.title: Brandi
SPIREBROTHERS-BRANDI.description:
[color=e8a0a3]Sister-in-Law.[/color]
Private Pyro. Army vet, sniper at heart, and Sparky to her friends.
She never says a word. Her face says it for her.
SPIREBROTHERS-BRANDI.cardsModifierDescri: Brandi cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
